name: Paseo
description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, and other coding agents in parallel on your own machines through a local daemon, controlled from desktop, mobile, web, a CLI, or a TypeScript SDK.

skills.name: Parallel Agent Runs
skills.description: Starts agents on a chosen provider and model with paseo run, optionally in a git worktree, then lists, attaches to, or messages them.

skills.name: Remote Daemon Control
skills.description: Runs tasks on another machine's daemon with --host, connected through an end-to-end encrypted relay, TCP, Tailscale, or a VPN.

skills.name: TypeScript SDK
skills.description: Builds issue integrations, dashboards, and orchestration services with @getpaseo/client, creating agents and waiting for their results.

skills.name: Agent Handoff Skills
skills.description: Hands work from one agent to another, asks a second agent for advice, or forms a two-agent committee with the bundled Paseo skills.
